findingApprovals.fpLevel.allHelp: Every false positive needs a second person to approve it.
findingApprovals.fpLevel.description: When marking a finding a false positive needs a second person. An accepted risk always needs a second person, whatever you choose here.
findingApprovals.fpLevel.high_and_aboveH: A second person approves a false positive on a critical or high finding, a known exploited vulnerability (KEV), P0 or P1, a validated exploit, or a crown-jewel or internet-exposed asset. Anyone with approval permission may decide the others alone.
findingApprovals.fpLevel.lowerDelay: A lower level takes effect 24 hours after you save it, and every approver is told. A higher level takes effect at once.
findingApprovals.fpLevel.lowerPercentDel: A lower second-look share takes effect 24 hours after you save it. A higher share takes effect at once.
findingApprovals.fpLevel.offHelp: Anyone with approval permission may mark any finding a false positive alone.
findingApprovals.fpLevel.offWarning: A single stolen session or a single mistake can mark a critical finding a false positive. Decisions stay audited and get a review flag when the finding later changes, but nobody checks them first.
findingApprovals.fpLevel.offWarningTitle: One person can hide any finding
findingApprovals.fpLevel.pendingBody: "{level}" takes effect at {at}. Until then "{current}" applies.
findingApprovals.fpLevel.pendingPercentB: {next} % takes effect at {at}. Until then {current} % of single-person decisions get a second look.
findingApprovals.fpLevel.pendingPercentT: A lower second-look share is waiting
findingApprovals.fpLevel.secondLookHelp: A random share of false positives decided by one person is flagged for another person to look at. 0 turns it off; at most 10.
findingApprovals.fpLevel.title: False-positive approval
findingApprovals.selfApprove.audited: It is recorded in the audit log and marked self-approved everywhere.
findingApprovals.selfApprove.badgeTitle: Approved by its own requester, the organization's only member
findingApprovals.selfApprove.description: Nobody else in your organization can decide this request. As its only member and owner you may approve it yourself.
findingApprovals.selfApprove.doneShorten: Approved. The acceptance was shortened to the limit for a self-approval.
findingApprovals.selfApprove.error.badCo: The code is wrong or was already used. Wait for a new code and try again.
findingApprovals.selfApprove.error.needs: Turn on two-factor authentication first: approving your own request needs a code from your authenticator app.
findingApprovals.selfApprove.error.notAl: You can approve your own request only as the owner of an organization with no other active member.
findingApprovals.selfApprove.limit: An accepted risk ends within 7 days (P0 or known exploited), 45 days (P1) or 90 days.
findingApprovals.selfApprove.reasonLabel: Why may it take effect without a second person?
findingApprovals.selfApprove.title: Approve your own request
findingApprovals.selfApprove.told: Your organization's notification channels and its backup contact are told.
findingApprovals.settings.backupDescript: An advisor or auditor outside the organization who is emailed whenever its only member approves their own finding request.
findingApprovals.settings.cancelFailed: Could not cancel the waiting change
findingApprovals.settings.savedPending: Saved. The lower level takes effect in 24 hours; the approvers were told.
findingApprovals.single.applied: Marked a false positive. It is recorded with your name and reason.
findingApprovals.single.badgeTitle: Decided by one person: the organization's false-positive level did not require a second
findingApprovals.single.notice: This organization doesn't require approval for this finding: it is marked a false positive at once. Choose a reason and explain it; the decision is audited and flagged for review if the finding later becomes more serious.
findingApprovals.single.othersNotice: A person with approval permission could mark this finding a false positive alone; your request waits for one of them.
findingApprovals.tier.singleHelp: The requester decides alone when they hold the approve permission.
findingApprovals.tier.securityHelp: One other person from the security pool decides after re-authenticating.
findingApprovals.tier.dualHelp: Two other people decide, at least one from the security pool, each after re-authenticating.
findingApprovals.reason.epss_at_or_above: EPSS at or above the threshold
findingApprovals.reason.group_decision: a decision for a group of findings
findingApprovals.reason.security_pool_fa: nobody in the security pool is eligible, so any approver may decide
findingApprovals.reason.not_enough_eligi: not enough people are eligible to approve
findingApprovals.refusal.asset_owner: You own this finding's asset, so you cannot approve hiding its risk.
findingApprovals.refusal.assignee: The finding is assigned to you, and your organization does not let the assignee approve.
findingApprovals.refusal.not_in_security: This request needs an approver from the security pool.
findingApprovals.refusal.requester: Another approver must decide your own request.
findingApprovals.refusal.not_an_approver: You are not an eligible approver for this finding.
findingApprovals.refusal.no_eligible_app: Nobody eligible can complete this approval. Add an approver or change the security pool.
findingApprovals.refusal.step_up: Confirm your identity to approve this request.
findingApprovals.policy.savedPending: Saved. The relaxed rules take effect in 24 hours; until then the stricter rules apply. The approvers were told.
findingApprovals.policy.pendingTitle: A relaxed approval policy is waiting
findingApprovals.policy.pendingBody: It takes effect at {at}. Until then the stricter rules of the old and the new policy apply.
findingApprovals.policy.tiersDescription: The approval each kind of request needs, by how risky the finding is. Only choices at or above the platform minimum are offered. A relaxing change takes effect 24 hours after you save it; a stricter one at once.
findingApprovals.policy.fpRowHint: Default follows the false-positive level above; a tier here only raises it.
findingApprovals.policy.poolDescription: Security review and two-approver requests need a sign-off from the security pool. When nobody in the pool is eligible, any approver may decide unless you turn that off.
findingApprovals.policy.poolNoPermission: You need permission to view groups to change the security pool.
findingApprovals.policy.strictHelp: When nobody in the pool is eligible, the request waits instead of falling back to any approver.
findingApprovals.policy.excludeAssigneeH: The finding's assignee may not approve its request. Asset owners and the requester are always excluded.
findingApprovals.policy.stepUpAllHelp: Peer approvers re-authenticate too. Security review and two-approver decisions always ask for it.
findingApprovals.policy.limitsDescriptio: Leave a field empty to use the platform value. A cap for one class also bounds the riskier classes.
findingApprovals.policy.capsHint: Platform caps by priority: P0 or KEV {p0} days, P1 {p1}, P2 {p2}, P3 {p3}. The shorter of the platform cap and yours applies.
findingApprovals.policy.decideWithinHelp: A pending request expires after this many days, from {min} to {max}.
findingApprovals.policy.epssHelp: A finding with an EPSS score at or above this counts as high risk, from {min} to {max}.
findingApprovals.policy.materialDescript: What happens to a decision when the finding later becomes riskier.
findingApprovals.policy.material.end_on_: End it when the finding needs a stricter approval
End it on any material change
findingApprovals.policy.materialSingleFP: False positive decided by one person
findingApprovals.evaluation.headline: {tier}: {count} approval(s) needed
findingApprovals.evaluation.whoDual: Two different people approve, at least one from the security pool. Eligible: {count} approvers, {pool} in the security pool.
findingApprovals.evaluation.whoPool: An approver from the security pool decides. Eligible in the pool: {count}.
findingApprovals.evaluation.fallback: Nobody in the security pool is eligible, so any approver may decide.
findingApprovals.evaluation.stepUp: Approvers confirm their identity before they decide.
findingApprovals.evaluation.maxDays: An acceptance of this finding lasts at most {days} days.
findingApprovals.evaluation.decideWithin: The request expires if nobody decides within {days} days.
findingApprovals.evaluation.unsatisfiabl: Your organization does not have enough eligible approvers for this request. It will wait until an administrator adds one or changes the security pool.
findingApprovals.evaluation.noteTooShort: Write at least {count} characters for this approval.
findingApprovals.policy.title: Approval policy
findingApprovals.policy.description: How many people approve each request, who they are, and how long a decision lasts. Changes are audited and every approver is told.
